meta.name: Kumari Srimathi
meta.description:
Srimathi is a 30 year old unmarried woman, with a dead end job, a dysfunctional family and a goal to win back her ancestral house. For that, she needs to raise a lot of money in a short period of time. Seeing a business oppurtunity, she decides to start a bar in her village. This is the journey of Srimathi, battling various societal and moral obstacles along the way.

Rated U/A 13+ · Ended · First aired 28 Sept 2023 · India · Language: Telugu
Studio: Early Monsoon Tales · Network: Prime Video

Complete series. On your server: S1 7/7

On your server — Audio: Telugu

videos.title: Rajnikanth. Abdul Kalam. Itikelapudi Srimathi.
videos.overview: The ancestral house goes the Uncle’s way, but Srimathi is presented with an opportunity to buy it, if she can somehow, get 38 lakhs in just six months.

videos.title: Muhurtalu Pettukondi
videos.overview: In the wake of Srimathi’s bold decision, the family tries to pinch themselves, while she goes on a mission to find the investment.

videos.title: Saarochhaaru
videos.overview: Now that she has agreed to marry, Srimathi is now presented with a new prospect, in the form of a tall pilot. Keshava Rao grows confident that Srimathi’s pursuits are a dead end.

videos.title: Taagipoduru Gaaka
videos.overview: Srimathi’s as close as ever to getting that bar license. But one thing stands in her way. Or one person?

videos.title: Laabhamgaa Thaagandi
videos.overview: Srimathi’s as close as ever to getting that bar license. But one thing stands in her way. Or one person?

videos.title: Kshemamgaa Thaagandi
videos.overview: Srimathi has to find a solution to bring the women of her village together. But the solution might mean her chances of winning the house back would be slim.

videos.title: Willa? Illa? Milla?
videos.overview: Keshava Rao and Timmaya’s diabolical plan works in their favour, leaving Srimathi falling short of money. While she’s desperate for those last few lakhs, a man re enters Srimathi’s life and stirs things up.
